title.en: Hydraulic cylinder is an outline for concrete pump delivery hose, not a second table
title.zh: 《液压气缸》是concrete pump delivery hose的大纲，不是第二张表

description.en: Section titles come from Hydraulic cylinder; the concrete pump delivery hose figures stay the printed ones. The Concrete Pump Delivery Hose is a flexible spare made in Xingtai. Photos show bulk rubber placing hoses with steel couplings packed for transport. Diameter and length are not printed as a table. Service life is not printed. The hose is not the straight red pipe and it is not the DN200 elbow.
description.zh: 节标题来自《液压气缸》，concrete pump delivery hose的数字仍是已印数字。混凝土泵输送胶管是邢台制造的柔性配件。照片是成批橡胶布料管，金属接头带运输包装。管径和长度没有印成表格。寿命没有印出。它不是红色直管，也不是 DN200 弯管。

h1.en: Hydraulic cylinder sets the order for the concrete pump delivery hose note
h1.zh: 《液压气缸》决定这篇concrete pump delivery hose笔记的次序

directAnswer.en: The short answer for concrete pump delivery hose uses the cells Xingtai already printed. Hydraulic cylinder is the outline those cells are filed under. The Concrete Pump Delivery Hose is a flexible spare made in Xingtai. Photos show bulk rubber placing hoses with steel couplings packed for transport. Diameter and length are not printed as a table. Service life is not printed. The hose is not the straight red pipe and it is not the DN200 elbow.
directAnswer.zh: concrete pump delivery hose的简答只用邢台已经印出的格子。《液压气缸》是这些格子所依的大纲。 混凝土泵输送胶管是邢台制造的柔性配件。照片是成批橡胶布料管，金属接头带运输包装。管径和长度没有印成表格。寿命没有印出。它不是红色直管，也不是 DN200 弯管。

body.en: The skeleton of this section is the source heading “Operation”. The technical content is only what Xingtai already printed. Part type: concrete pump delivery / placing hose. Ends: steel couplings, factory-protected for transport. Diameter and length: quoted after the pump model. Packing: project quantities from factory stock. No small-batch shipping and no published list price. Material grade beyond the rubber hose description, pressure rating and service life are missing fields. The heading stops there.
body.zh: 这一节的骨架是来源标题“操作”。技术内容只限于邢台已经印出的部分。 配件类型：混凝土泵输送 / 布料胶管。接头：金属接头，出厂防护包装。管径和长度：对照泵型号后报价。包装：工厂备货，按工程量。不支持小批量发货，无公开标价。橡胶管这一描述之外的材料牌号、压力等级和寿命都是缺字段。 标题到此为止。

body.en: The heading “Applications” is structural. What it is allowed to carry is the wording already on the row for this note. B500S-83D prints a delivery-hose cell that says Standard. It does not print a DN or a length, and it does not say that cell is this spare. The six pumps with a steel-pipe diameter cell do not name this hose. Do not copy 80 mm or 100 / 125 mm onto the hose unless that diameter is confirmed for the hose on the machine. The heading stops there.
body.zh: 标题“用途”只起骨架作用。它能够携带的，是这篇笔记对应那一行已经印出的文字。 B500S-83D 有一格输送胶管，原文是“标准”。它没有印公称直径或长度，也没有写这一格就是这件配件。六台印了钢管管径的泵没有点名这根胶管。除非已在机器上确认胶管直径，否则不要把 80 mm 或 100 / 125 mm 抄到胶管上。 标题到此为止。

body.en: “Parts” organises the source article. Organised under it here is catalogue language, unchanged in its figures. Hebei Pinjin Machinery (河北品锦机械) in Xingtai does not print a list price for this spare, and the page does not sell it as a small parcel. Write through the contact page by email or WhatsApp. Send the pump model, the hose inner diameter if you have confirmed it, the length and the quantity. Leave pressure rating and life blank. Unprinted cells stay unprinted.
body.zh: “零件”用来组织来源文章。组织在它下面的，是目录里的说法，数字保持原样。 邢台河北品锦机械没有为这件配件公布标价，也不按小包裹销售。请走联系页，用邮件或 WhatsApp 写给工厂。 写上泵型号、已经核对过的胶管内径、长度和数量。压力等级和寿命留空。 没有印出的格子保持不印。

body.en: Read “Designs” as the source author’s section, not as a Pinjin test result. The sentence that follows is the printed fragment. The Concrete Pump Delivery Hose is a flexible spare made in Xingtai. Photos show bulk rubber placing hoses with steel couplings packed for transport. Diameter and length are not printed as a table. Service life is not printed. The hose is not the straight red pipe and it is not the DN200 elbow. No neighbouring page’s figure is copied onto this row.
body.zh: 把“来源章节：Designs”读成来源作者的分节，不要读成品锦的试验结果。后面跟的是已印片段。 混凝土泵输送胶管是邢台制造的柔性配件。照片是成批橡胶布料管，金属接头带运输包装。管径和长度没有印成表格。寿命没有印出。它不是红色直管，也不是 DN200 弯管。 不把旁边那一页的数字抄到这一行。

body.en: Where the source outline says “Piston rod construction”, the catalogue fragment below is the fragment a buyer is allowed to copy. No. The hose page is a rubber placing hose with steel couplings. The pipe page is a red straight pipe with coupling ends. The heading stops there.
body.zh: 来源大纲写到“活塞杆 构造”时，下面这句才是买方可以照抄的目录原文。 不是。胶管页是带金属接头的橡胶布料管。直管页是带快接端的红色直管。 标题到此为止。

heading.zh: 来源章节：Distribution of forces on components

body.en: The contents list of the source page includes “Distribution of forces on components”. This section borrows that name and then repeats a printed fragment. No. The cell says Standard. DN is a missing field on that page. The heading stops there.
body.zh: 来源页目录里有“来源章节：Distribution of forces on components”。本节借用这个名字，然后复述已经印出的片段。 没有。那一格写的是“标准”。公称直径在该页是缺字段。 标题到此为止。

body.en: The source page divides this subject at “Cylinder mounting methods”. The words under that heading, in this note, stay inside the Xingtai wording already printed. Hebei Pinjin Machinery (河北品锦机械) in Xingtai does not print a list price for this spare, and the page does not sell it as a small parcel. Write through the contact page by email or WhatsApp. Unprinted cells stay unprinted.
body.zh: 来源页在“气缸安装方式方法”处分开叙述。这一节沿用该标题，底下只重复邢台已经印出的说法。 邢台河北品锦机械没有为这件配件公布标价，也不按小包裹销售。请走联系页，用邮件或 WhatsApp 写给工厂。 没有印出的格子保持不印。

body.en: The skeleton of this section is the source heading “Special hydraulic cylinders”. The technical content is only what Xingtai already printed. A service life, a replacement-hour figure and a wear-rate table are not printed. Leave that field blank. The heading stops there. Image from the source page: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hydraulic_cylinder
body.zh: 这一节的骨架是来源标题“专用液压缸”。技术内容只限于邢台已经印出的部分。 使用寿命、更换小时和磨损速率都没有印出。这一栏留空。 标题到此为止。 图来自来源页：https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hydraulic_cylinder

question.en: What should an inquiry repeat for concrete pump delivery hose under the heading “Cylinder mounting methods”?
question.zh: 询价concrete pump delivery hose时，在“气缸安装方式方法”这一节应当重复什么？

answer.en: No. The hose page is a rubber placing hose with steel couplings. The pipe page is a red straight pipe with coupling ends. The heading and the source photograph do not add a further figure.
answer.zh: 不是。胶管页是带金属接头的橡胶布料管。直管页是带快接端的红色直管。 章节标题和来源图片都不另加数字。
